parts.why: the Han River bank, from Jamsil Bridge west
Songpa-daero, Seokchon Lake and Jamsil Station

meta.source: hand-made game map: Songpa-gu across the Han River. Seokchon Lake is at the real 1/4 scale like the rest of Seoul (docs/WORLD.md): both lakes and the west-lake island were traced from the real map, centred on the lake's own centre on Songpa-daero, then shrunk to 1/4 (about 13,500 m2 of water here, the real 217,850 m2 / 16 = 13,616). Songpa-daero runs south-east from Jamsil Bridge to the Olympic-ro corner (540, 100), kept clear for Jamsil Station, then bends through the gap between the two lakes. The land the lakes gave back is lakeside park. Another Land on the west-lake island is an original theme park, not a real place; Another Land Bridge runs south from Olympic-ro to the island's north tip, where its gate faces north (landmark ry). Olympic Park, further east along Olympic-ro, is its own district (olympic-park.json); a path runs from the east lake to its park. Seoul Another Dome (a fictional baseball dome, inspired by the one planned for Jamsil) stands west of Jamsil Station by the river, at the west end of Olympic-ro. The HANEUL department store and mall (fictional brand) stand between Olympic-ro and the lakes, where the real shopping complex by Jamsil Station is; the mall sits clear of the east lake's north tip. Another Tower (fictional, where the real 555 m tower is, at 1/4: 139 m) stands just south-east of Jamsil Station. They are drawn by core/haneul.js. No filler blocks: the open ground by the river and the lakes is left clear.
